description: Create a new order confirmation from a quotation via `POST /order-confirmations?precedingSalesVoucherId={id}`. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

body.description: Order confirmation JSON body with voucherDate, address, lineItems, totalPrice, and taxConditions. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

precedingSalesVoucherId.description: UUID of the preceding quotation that this order confirmation is pursued from.

name: lexware_pursue_order_confirmation
title: Pursue to an Order Confirmation
